subject: SOW implementation window / ops runbook — proposed amendment & redlines
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara@acmehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.example>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.example>
Cc: Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@acmelegal.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed change order + SOW implementation window

Hi Hannah / Connor,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We reviewed the implementation plan with our infra and product teams and have three items we want captured in an amendment so procurement can push this to legal:

- Add 200 dedicated GPU hours/month for pilot months 1–3 (then revert to baseline).
- Clarify the SOW implementation window: ACME needs a hard start date window (Nov 15 — Dec 1) and an early acceptance checkpoint at day 21.
- A short-term bridging credit (one-time) to offset go-live training costs.

I attached a draft change order (Acme_Proposed_Change_Order_v2.pdf) with the capacity table and proposed payment milestones. Please confirm whether Redwood can accept the window language and the acceptance criteria as written, or if you prefer alternate phrasing.

Also looping in Tom from our legal team to keep the review timeline tight. Procurement is hoping to get a countersigned amendment by Oct 23. Is that feasible?

Next steps I propose: internal redline, then a 30-minute legal sync early next week.

Thanks,

—Sara Patel
Sr. Manager, Strategic Procurement
Acme Health
attachments: Acme_Proposed_Change_Order_v2.pdf (PDF, 312KB)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.example>
To: Sara Patel <sara@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.example>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example>, Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@acmelegal.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed change order + SOW implementation window

Sara — thanks for the clear ask and for attaching the proposed CO. We can meet the general intent here but have a few legal/ops notes before we can sign to scope:

- Capacity: we can add the 200 GPU hours/month for the 3-month pilot. Need to align on the measurement unit (GPU-hour vs. allocation slots). Ops prefers "allocated GPU hours" in the CO.
- Implementation window: Nov 15 — Dec 1 is workable but we need an explicit fall-back clause in case provisioning is delayed by >7 calendar days. Suggested fallback: automatic push to next available provisioning window + credit for missed SLA hours.
- Acceptance criteria: the day-21 checkpoint is fine; we'll add an "acceptance plan" exhibit with a small prompt-set and throughput smoke tests.
- Bridging credit: we can offer a one-time $10K onboarding credit that flows against month-1 invoice.

Connor — can you produce a redline of the SOW and a short ops-runbook that codifies the provisioning checklist and fallback? Laura — can you flag any legal exposures on the proposed fallback language and the credit mechanics?

I can do a 30-minute sync Monday 10/12 10:00–10:30 PT if that works for everyone.

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
+1 650-555-0147
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.example>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.example>, Sara Patel <sara@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 13:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed change order + SOW implementation window (redlines attached)

Hi all — redlines attached. High-level from ops/implementation:

1) Provisioning unit: switched to "allocated GPU hours" and added a definition for start/stop of accounting (UTC timestamps + customer confirmation).
2) Fallback: replaced generic language with an actionable sequence: (a) ops notifies customer within 48 hours of any provisioning delay, (b) Redwood offers next available slot within 14 days or a pro-rata credit for missed allocation for pilot months.
3) Acceptance: added the smoke test matrix (latency < 120ms p95, throughput target 500 reqs/min for 10-minute window) as Exhibit F.
4) Credit mechanics: onboarding credit applied as an invoice-level credit and explicitly non-refundable; reconciliation to be part of month-1 invoice.

I attached redlined_SOW_connor_v1.docx with inline comments on implementation tasks and deployment owners.

Connor
Connor O'Brien
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
attachments: redlined_SOW_connor_v1.docx (DOCX, 128KB)

From: Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@acmelegal.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.example>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.example>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara@acmehealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 08:13:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed change order + SOW implementation window — legal comments

Hannah / Connor — thanks for the quick turnaround and the redlines, Connor. A couple of legal points from Acme's side:

- Fallback wording: we can accept a fallback but need a cap on the pro-rata credit (suggested cap = 20% of month value for that pilot month) and an explicit remedy timeline.
- Credit treatment: Acme needs the onboarding credit to be applied as a prepayment credit that can be offset against professional services if provisioning is late — not simply an invoice-level credit we can dispute.
- Data & audit: request to add a short paragraph to Exhibit F that requires Redwood to provide an audit log (redacted) of provisioning events for the pilot period.

I put comments inline in the PDF and also created a short follow-up DocuSign envelope for the CO once we reach final language (link below). If you incorporate the cap + audit log, I think we can meet your Oct 23 timeline — subject to our internal signatory availability.

Tom Rivers
Counsel, Acme Legal
Tom.Rivers@acmelegal.com

Subject: Re: Proposed change order + SOW implementation window — next steps and sync

Thanks Tom — useful flags. Quick internal note and proposed path forward:

1) Ops will add the explicit cap language and an audit log obligation to Exhibit F (Connor to update by EOD 10/13).
2) Finance will confirm the mechanics for "prepayment credit vs invoice credit" but our preference is prepayment reconciliation; Laura, can you confirm whether we need contract language changes to make the credit non-disputable?
3) Hannah to run a 30-minute legal + ops sync Tue 10/13 9:00–9:30 PT to walk the final redline. Please accept the calendar invite if that time works.

Attachments: sow-exhibit-e-runbook_v1.pdf (PDF, 220KB) — this is the ops runbook draft Connor referenced; it includes provisioning steps, owner on-call matrix, and the smoke test checklist.

If all goes well with the cap + audit wording we should be able to get the CO routed for signatures and the DocuSign envelope executed by Oct 22.

Hannah
